FROM players AS T1
INNER JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.winner_id OR T1.player_id = T2.loser_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN T1.player_id = T2.winner_id THEN T2.winner_age ELSE T2.loser_age END

SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name, p.last_name
FROM players p
LEFT JOIN matches m ON p.player_id = m.winner_id OR p.player_id = m.loser_id
ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN p.player_id = m.winner_id THEN m.winner_age
    WHEN p.player_id = m.loser_id THEN m.loser_age
  END

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name
FROM players p
JOIN matches m ON p.player_id = m.winner_id
UNION
SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name
FROM players p
JOIN matches m ON p.player_id = m.loser_id
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT winner_age FROM matches WHERE winner_id = p.player_id LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT loser_age FROM matches WHERE loser_id = p.player_id LIMIT 1)
  )

    UNION
    SELECT loser_name AS player_name, loser_age AS age FROM matches
) m ON p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name = m.player_name
